description.value: Kuroki Kaiseki Omakase Kitchen is a Japanese restaurant in Richmond's Chatham Street area specializing in kaiseki-style omakase dining, a multi-course format curated entirely by the chef. Omakase restaurants typically offer an intimate, counter-style experience that can be a memorable stop for a touring cyclist seeking a distinctive meal in Metro Vancouver's food-rich Richmond district.
